findings.text: the held-row branch clears next_action before the new manifest_blocked test, so the combined row now reads blocked while handing the reader no command, although the classifier's own next_action for it is a read-and-resolve instruction ending 'once the lane clears' (tests/test_blocked_names_both_reasons.py:139), not a launch; the reason stated at 1432 names a launch that does not apply, and every other blocked row in the pane carries an act.

the base and head arm logs are cited only by job id (1327127, 1327130) with no path and are not committed beside the head run, and the importer log headers carry an unsubstituted '<population>' placeholder (importer-base.log:4), so once the host run directory is swept the negative control the plan's done-when asks for cannot be opened from the record.
